headline: As of 2026-10-09: 2,889,719 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+26.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 2,889,719 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+26.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (481,274), Virginia (479,785), Michigan (346,482).
